capabilities: Render chess positions from FEN or PGN in code blocks
Flip board orientation between white and black perspective
Highlight squares and draw arrows on the board
Customize board size, colors, highlights and arrows in settings
Add custom chess piece sets via styles.css
extras: README includes a roadmap of unimplemented features such as PGN move browsing and board coordinate display.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render chess positions from notation in notes.
summary: Chess position renderer that displays FEN or PGN positions as boards inside shaahmaat code blocks, with highlights, arrows and custom sets.
